title: Was Confucius a Hunk?
synopsis: Is this information in-line with your mental image of Confucius?

fullText.simplified:
“孔子”是肌肉猛男？

    “孔子”是中国古代的大教育家、大思想家。我们看到的孔子的画像也是安安静静的形象。可是你知道吗？孔子可能是个肌肉猛男哦！
    据说，孔子的老爸力大无穷。老爸厉害，儿子孔子应该也不会差。根据历史资料记载，孔子力气非常大，他可以用一只手举起古代城门的门闩。古代城门的门闩非常非常重，需要三四个壮汉一起抬才能抬起来。一般来说，力气大的人，肌肉都大。孔子力气这么大，应该就是那种很壮的身材。看完身材，再来看看孔子的身高。很多书上都写过孔子的身高，最矮的身高都有189厘米，这样的身高放到现在也是个大高个儿。
    从上边提到的三个线索，不难看出，孔子真有可能是个又高又壮的肌肉猛男！
fullText.traditional:
“孔子”是肌肉猛男？

    “孔子”是中國古代的大教育家、大思想家。我們看到的孔子的畫像也是安安靜靜的形象。可是你知道嗎？孔子可能是個肌肉猛男哦！
    據說，孔子的老爸力大無窮。老爸厲害，兒子孔子應該也不會差。根據歷史資料記載，孔子力氣非常大，他可以用一隻手舉起古代城門的門閂。古代城門的門閂非常非常重，需要三四個壯漢一起抬才能抬起來。一般來說，力氣大的人，肌肉都大。孔子力氣這麼大，應該就是那種很壯的身材。看完身材，再來看看孔子的身高。很多書上都寫過孔子的身高，最矮的身高都有189釐米，這樣的身高放到現在也是個大高個兒。
    從上邊提到的三個線索，不難看出，孔子真有可能是個又高又壯的肌肉猛男！

sentences.simplified: “孔子”是中国古代的大教育家、大思想家。
sentences.traditional: “孔子”是中國古代的大教育家、大思想家。
sentences.pinyin: kǒng zǐ shì zhōng guó gǔ dài de dà jiào yù jiā dà sī xiǎng jiā

sentences.simplified: 我们看到的孔子的画像也是安安静静的形象。
sentences.traditional: 我們看到的孔子的畫像也是安安靜靜的形象。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men kàn dào de kǒng zǐ de huà xiàng yě shì ān ān jìng jìng de xíng xiàng
sentences.english: Confucius was a great educator and thinker in ancient China.

sentences.simplified: 可是你知道吗？孔子可能是个肌肉猛男哦！
sentences.traditional: 可是你知道嗎？孔子可能是個肌肉猛男哦！
sentences.pinyin: kě shì nǐ zhī dào ma kǒng zǐ kě néng shì ge jī ròu měng nán o
sentences.english: The portraits of Confucius we see also present a peaceful and serene image.
But, did you know? Confucius may have been a hunk!

sentences.simplified: 据说，孔子的老爸力大无穷。
sentences.traditional: 據說，孔子的老爸力大無窮。
sentences.pinyin: jù shuō kǒng zǐ de lǎo bà lì dà wú qióng

sentences.simplified: 老爸厉害，儿子孔子应该也不会差。
sentences.traditional: 老爸厲害，兒子孔子應該也不會差。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo bà lì hai ér zi kǒng zǐ yīng gāi yě bú huì chà
sentences.english: It is said that Confucius’ father had extraordinary strength.

sentences.simplified: 根据历史资料记载，孔子力气非常大，
sentences.traditional: 根據歷史資料記載，孔子力氣非常大，
sentences.pinyin: gēn jù lì shǐ zī liào jì zǎi kǒng zǐ lì qi fēi cháng dà
sentences.english: The father was strong, so the son, Confucius, probably wouldn’t have been much different.

sentences.simplified: 他可以用一只手举起古代城门的门闩。
sentences.traditional: 他可以用一隻手舉起古代城門的門閂。
sentences.pinyin: tā kě yǐ yòng yì zhī shǒu jú qǐ gǔ dài chéng mén de mén shuān
sentences.english: According to historical records, Confucius was very strong.

sentences.simplified: 古代城门的门闩非常非常重，
sentences.traditional: 古代城門的門閂非常非常重，
sentences.pinyin: gǔ dài chéng mén de mén shuān fēi cháng fēi cháng zhòng
sentences.english: He could lift the bolt of an ancient city gate with one hand.

sentences.simplified: 需要三四个壮汉一起抬才能抬起来。
sentences.traditional: 需要三四個壯漢一起抬才能抬起來。
sentences.pinyin: xū yào sān sì ge zhuàng hàn yì qǐ tái cái néng tái qǐ lái
sentences.english: The bolts of ancient city gates were extremely heavy.

sentences.simplified: 一般来说，力气大的人，肌肉都大。
sentences.traditional: 一般來說，力氣大的人，肌肉都大。
sentences.pinyin: yì bān lái shuō lì qi dà de rén jī ròu dōu dà
sentences.english: They could only be lifted by the joint effort of three to four strong men.

sentences.simplified: 孔子力气这么大，应该就是那种很壮的身材。
sentences.traditional: 孔子力氣這麼大，應該就是那種很壯的身材。
sentences.pinyin: kǒng zǐ lì qi zhè me dà yīng gāi jiù shì nà zhǒng hěn zhuàng de shēn cái
sentences.english: Generally speaking, strong people have big muscles.

sentences.simplified: 看完身材，再来看看孔子的身高。
sentences.traditional: 看完身材，再來看看孔子的身高。
sentences.pinyin: kàn wán shēn cái zài lái kàn kan kǒng zǐ de shēn gāo
sentences.english: Confucius had great strength, so he must have had a sturdy physique.

sentences.simplified: 很多书上都写过孔子的身高，最矮的身高都有189厘米，
sentences.traditional: 很多書上都寫過孔子的身高，最矮的身高都有189釐米，
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō shū shang dōu xiě guò kǒng zǐ de shēn gāo zuì ǎi de shēn gāo dōu yǒu 5 lí mǐ
sentences.english: We’ve talked about his body type. Now let’s take a look at his height.

sentences.simplified: 这样的身高放到现在也是个大高个儿。
sentences.traditional: 這樣的身高放到現在也是個大高個兒。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng de shēn gāo fàng dào xiàn zài yě shì ge dà gāo gè'r
sentences.english: Confucius’s height has been mentioned in many books, with the shortest height mentioned being 189 cm.
Even nowadays, he would still be considered tall.

sentences.simplified: 从上边提到的三个线索，不难看出，孔子真有可能是个又高又壮的肌肉猛男！
sentences.traditional: 從上邊提到的三個線索，不難看出，孔子真有可能是個又高又壯的肌肉猛男！
sentences.pinyin: cóng shàng bian tí dào de sān ge xiàn suǒ bù nán kàn chū kǒng zǐ zhēn yǒu kě néng shì ge yòu gāo yòu zhuàng de jī ròu měng nán

raw.synopsis: Is this information in-line with your mental image of Confucius?
sentence_translations: Confucius was a great educator and thinker in ancient China.
The portraits of Confucius we see also present a peaceful and serene image.
But, did you know? Confucius may have been a hunk!
It is said that Confucius’ father had extraordinary strength.
The father was strong, so the son, Confucius, probably wouldn’t have been much different.
According to historical records, Confucius was very strong.
He could lift the bolt of an ancient city gate with one hand.
The bolts of ancient city gates were extremely heavy.
They could only be lifted by the joint effort of three to four strong men.
Generally speaking, strong people have big muscles.
Confucius had great strength, so he must have had a sturdy physique.
We’ve talked about his body type. Now let’s take a look at his height.
Confucius’s height has been mentioned in many books, with the shortest height mentioned being 189 cm.
Even nowadays, he would still be considered tall.
Based on the three clues mentioned above, it’s not hard to see that Confucius probably was a tall and strong hunk!
